acceptance: Interactive and terminal scored rounds use identical source, integrity, performance, memory and qualified quality gates on the complete frozen cohort; ordinary evaluation requires FROZEN qualified policies and a matching calibrated reference. Invalid submissions have no accepted score.

labels.quality_hard_gate: Quality policy qualified and enforced in every scored round
labels.quality_ok: Quality retention against the frozen reference (non-blocking until qualified)

reference.determinism: identical inputs must produce identical outputs; repeat and cross-request cache-isolation tests
reference.interface: runtime.api.GenerationSpec in, runtime.api.GenerationResult out; prompt prefix preserved bit-for-bit, every requested slot filled, no mask tokens, valid vocabulary ids
reference.memory: device-relative peak cap floor(total_device_memory_mib) - memory_reserve_mib plus row sentinel and repeat-growth guards
reference.model_use: sampled weight fingerprint before and after; 32-layer coverage; the supplied model must be used
reference.quality: Same semantic accuracy, parseability, executable-code outcomes and useful-output retention against the profile-matched frozen producer reference in every scored round; a hard gate once the quality policy is QUALIFIED.
reference.source: static admission of solutions/decoder_vNNN (allowed import roots, no reflection, no file access, size limits)
reference.timing: trusted root controller measures each request round trip; row throughput is sum(tokens) / sum(seconds), never a mean of ratios
